newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura affiliate JAFCO confirms prosecutors' raid.
newsitem.headline: Nomura affiliate JAFCO confirms prosecutors' raid.

text.p: Japan Associated Finance Co Ltd (JAFCO), an affiliate finance firm of Nomura Securities Co Ltd, confirmed that Tokyo prosecutors raided its headquarters on Friday.
However, a spokesman for the company said he did not know the reason for the raid.
Jiji news agency reported earlier on Friday that prosecutors had begun searching Nomura and JAFCO's headquarters for evidence of suspected illegal payoffs.
On Thursday, prosecutors indicted former Nomura president Hideo Sakamaki on charges of making illegal payoffs to corporate racketeer Ryuichi Koike.

They also served Sakamaki and two other former Nomura executives with new arrest warrants alleging they conspired to pay Koike 320 million yen around March 24, 1995, in exchange for a pledge by him to ensure the firm's June shareholders' meeting went smoothly.
